name: Crafter
description: You gain proficiency with three kinds of Artisan's Tools, pay 20% less for nonmagical goods, and after a Long Rest can quickly craft one simple item tied to tools you know; it lasts until your next Long Rest.

name: Healer
description: With a Healer's Kit you can use a Utilize action to let a nearby creature spend a Hit Die and heal it plus your Proficiency Bonus. You also reroll any 1s on healing dice you roll for spells or this feat.

name: Lucky
description: You have Luck Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus (regained on a Long Rest); spend one to give yourself Advantage on a D20 Test or to impose Disadvantage on an attack roll made against you.

name: Musician
description: You gain proficiency with three musical instruments, and after a Short or Long Rest you can play a song that gives Heroic Inspiration to a number of allies equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Tavern Brawler
description: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d4 + Strength modifier damage and you reroll 1s on that damage; you're proficient with improvised weapons, and once per turn an Unarmed Strike hit during the Attack action can also push the target 5 feet.

name: Tough
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by twice your character level when you take this feat, and by 2 more each time you gain a level.

name: Actor
description: You have Advantage on Deception and Performance checks while disguised as someone else, and you can mimic voices and sounds; seeing through it takes an Insight check against DC 8 + Cha mod + PB.

name: Athlete
description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, standing up from Prone costs only 5 feet of movement, and you can make running jumps after moving just 5 feet.

name: Charger
description: Dashing adds 10 feet to your Speed. Once per turn, after moving 10+ feet straight toward a target and hitting it with a melee attack, you either deal an extra 1d8 damage or push it 10 feet.

name: Chef
description: You gain Cook's Utensils proficiency. Food you cook on a Short Rest heals an extra 1d8 when allies spend Hit Dice, and after a Long Rest you can bake treats (PB of them) that grant Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus when eaten as a Bonus Action.

name: Crossbow Expert
description: You ignore the Loading property of crossbows and don't suffer Disadvantage for shooting them with an enemy beside you; when you make the Light-property extra attack with a Light crossbow (such as a Hand Crossbow) you can add your ability modifier to its damage.

name: Crusher
description: Once per turn when you deal Bludgeoning damage you can shove the target 5 feet; on a Critical Hit with Bludgeoning damage, attacks against that target have Advantage until your next turn starts.

name: Defensive Duelist
description: While holding a Finesse weapon, when a melee attack hits you, your Reaction adds your Proficiency Bonus to your AC against melee attacks until the start of your next turn, possibly turning the hit into a miss.

name: Dual Wielder
description: After attacking with a Light weapon during the Attack action, your Bonus Action extra attack can use any melee weapon without the Two-Handed property; you can also draw or stow two weapons at once.

name: Durable
description: You have Advantage on Death Saving Throws, and as a Bonus Action you can spend one Hit Die to heal.

name: Elemental Adept
prerequisite: Level 4+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: Pick Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder: your spells ignore Resistance to that type, and you treat 1s on that type's damage dice as 2s.
note: Repeatable; choose a different damage type each time.

name: Fey Touched
description: You learn Misty Step plus one level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell; both are always prepared and each can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, using the ability you increased.

name: Great Weapon Master
description: Hits with a Heavy weapon during the Attack action deal extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and after a Critical Hit or dropping a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon you can attack again as a Bonus Action.

name: Heavily Armored
description: You gain training with Heavy armor.

name: Heavy Armor Master
description: While you wear Heavy armor, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take from attacks is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Inspiring Leader
description: After a Short or Long Rest you can rally up to six creatures (yourself included), giving each Temporary Hit Points equal to your character level plus the modifier of the ability you increased.

name: Keen Mind
description: You gain proficiency (or Expertise if already proficient) in Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion, and can take the Study action as a Bonus Action.

parts.note: Expertise instead if you already have proficiency.

name: Lightly Armored
description: You gain training with Light armor and Shields.

name: Mage Slayer
description: Creatures you damage have Disadvantage on saves to keep Concentration, and once per Short or Long Rest you can turn a failed Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save into a success.

name: Martial Weapon Training
description: You gain proficiency with Martial weapons.

name: Medium Armor Master
description: While wearing Medium armor, you can add up to 3 (instead of 2) from Dexterity to your AC if your Dexterity is 16 or higher.

name: Moderately Armored
description: You gain training with Medium armor and Shields.

name: Mounted Combatant
description: While mounted you have Advantage on melee attacks against smaller unmounted foes near your mount, your mount takes no damage on a successful Dexterity save (half on a failure), and you can redirect attacks aimed at your mount to yourself.

name: Observant
description: You gain proficiency (or Expertise if already proficient) in Insight, Investigation, or Perception, and can take the Search action as a Bonus Action.

parts.note: Expertise instead if you already have proficiency.

name: Piercer
description: Once per turn you can reroll one Piercing damage die, and a Critical Hit with Piercing damage adds one more damage die.

name: Poisoner
description: Your Poison damage ignores Resistance, you gain Poisoner's Kit proficiency, and you can brew potent doses that deal 2d8 Poison damage and inflict Poisoned on a failed Constitution save.

name: Polearm Master
description: After attacking with a Quarterstaff, Spear, or Heavy Reach weapon, you can strike with the butt end (1d4 Bludgeoning) as a Bonus Action, and you can make an Opportunity Attack when a creature enters your reach.

name: Resilient
description: Choose an ability whose saving throw you aren't proficient in: increase it by 1 and gain proficiency in its saving throw.
note: Repeatability in the 2024 rules not confirmed; treated as non-repeatable.

name: Ritual Caster
description: You always have a number of level 1 Ritual spells prepared equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and once per Long Rest you can cast one of them at its normal casting time without using a slot.

parts.note: Number of spells equals your Proficiency Bonus; add one when it rises.

name: Sentinel
description: You can make an Opportunity Attack when a nearby enemy Disengages or attacks someone other than you, and a creature you hit with an Opportunity Attack has its Speed reduced to 0 for the turn.

name: Shadow Touched
description: You learn Invisibility plus one level 1 Illusion or Necromancy spell; both are always prepared and each can be cast once per Long Rest without a slot, using the ability you increased.

name: Sharpshooter
description: Your ranged weapon attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover, and you take no Disadvantage on them at long range or with an enemy next to you.

name: Shield Master
description: Once per turn when you hit with a melee weapon while holding a Shield, you can force a Strength save to push the target 5 feet or knock it Prone; your Reaction can also negate damage from an effect when you succeed on a Dexterity save.

name: Skill Expert
description: You gain proficiency in one skill and Expertise in one skill you're proficient in.

name: Skulker
description: You gain Blindsight 10 feet, have Advantage on Stealth checks to Hide during combat, and missing an attack while hidden doesn't give away your position.

name: Slasher
description: Once per turn when you deal Slashing damage you can cut the target's Speed by 10 feet until your next turn; a Critical Hit with Slashing damage also gives it Disadvantage on attacks until then.

name: Speedy
description: Your Speed increases by 10 feet, Dashing lets you ignore Difficult Terrain that turn, and Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage.

name: Spell Sniper
prerequisite: Level 4+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: Your spell attacks ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover and aren't hampered by adjacent enemies, and attack-roll spells with a range of at least 10 feet reach 60 feet farther.

name: Telekinetic
description: You learn Mage Hand, which you can cast silently with an invisible hand (extra range if you already knew it), and as a Bonus Action you can shove a creature within 30 feet 5 feet unless it passes a Strength save.

name: Telepathic
description: You can speak telepathically to creatures within 60 feet, and you can cast Detect Thoughts once per Long Rest without a slot or components.

name: War Caster
prerequisite: Level 4+; Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature
description: You have Advantage on Constitution saves to keep Concentration, can perform Somatic components with your hands full, and can cast a single-target spell instead of making an Opportunity Attack.

name: Weapon Master
description: You can use the mastery property of one kind of Simple or Martial weapon you're proficient with, and you can swap that choice when you finish a Long Rest.

name: Blind Fighting
description: You gain Blindsight with a range of 10 feet.

name: Dueling
description: While you wield a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapon, you deal +2 damage with it.

name: Interception
description: While holding a Shield or a Simple or Martial weapon, your Reaction reduces damage dealt to a creature within 5 feet of you by 1d10 + your Proficiency Bonus.

name: Protection
description: While holding a Shield, your Reaction imposes Disadvantage on an attack against an ally within 5 feet of you, and on other attacks against that ally until your next turn while you stay close.

name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
description: You can draw a Thrown weapon as part of the attack, and ranged attacks with Thrown weapons deal +2 damage.

name: Unarmed Fighting
description: Your Unarmed Strikes deal 1d6 + Strength modifier damage (1d8 if you hold no weapon or Shield), and at the start of your turn you can deal 1d4 Bludgeoning damage to a creature you're grappling.

name: Boon of Energy Resistance
description: You resist two damage types of your choice (changeable on a Long Rest), and when you take damage of one of them your Reaction can force a creature within 60 feet to make a Dexterity save or take 2d12 + Con modifier damage of that type.

name: Boon of Fortitude
description: Your Hit Point maximum increases by 40, and once per turn when you regain Hit Points you regain extra equal to your Constitution modifier.

name: Boon of Recovery
description: Once per Long Rest, dropping to 0 HP instead leaves you at 1 HP and restores half your Hit Point maximum; you also have a pool of ten d10s you can roll as a Bonus Action to heal.

name: Boon of Skill
description: You become proficient in every skill and gain Expertise in one of them.

name: Boon of Speed
description: Your Speed increases by 30 feet, and you can Disengage as a Bonus Action, which also frees you from a grapple.
